title_sq: Tek Liqeni i Farkes, Shitet Super Vile Premium Ne Residence Luksoze!!!
description_sq: Liqeni I Farkes Shitet Vile Premium Ne Residence Luksoze!!! Vila e tipit individual perbehet nga 3 kate banim me siperfaqe totale 257 m2, te organizuar ne katin perdhe nga salloni i ndenies me pamje fantastke nga liqeni, ambienti i gatimit dhe ngrenies me vete, tualet si dhe nje ambient sherbimesh si lavanteri dhe depo. Kati i pare perbeht nga dy dhoma gjumi, tualet me dritare dhe koridori hyres.Ne katin e dyte gjendet dhoma matrimoniale e bollshme me dalje ne veranden fantastike me pamje nga Liqeni i Farkes, me garderobe dhe tualet te brendshem me dritare. Vila disponon siperfaqe prej 240 m2, siperfaqe verande 82.4 m2 si dhe dy poste parkimi. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte duke u zhvilluar me ndertime elitare rezidenciale dhe ofron qetesi maksimale, ajer te paster, pamje mahnitese nga liqeni, akses te shpejt me unazen e madhe etj. Aktualisht vila eshte ne proces ndertimi ku ka perfunduar karabinaja dhe pritet te fillojne ndarjet me tulla.
title_en: At Farke Lake, Premium Super Villa for Sale in a Luxury Residence!!!
description_en: Farke Lake Premium Villa for Sale in a Luxury Residence!!! The individual villa consists of 3 residential floors with a total area of ​​257 m2, organized on the ground floor by a living room with a fantastic view of the lake, a separate cooking and dining area, a toilet and a service area such as a laundry room and a storage room. The first floor consists of two bedrooms, a bathroom with a window and an entrance hall. On the second floor, there is a spacious matrimonial room with access to the fantastic veranda with a view of Lake Farka, with a wardrobe and an internal toilet with a window. The villa has an area of ​​240 m2, a veranda area of ​​82.4 m2 and two parking spaces. The area in which it is located is being developed with elite residential buildings and offers maximum tranquility, clean air, stunning views from the lake, quick access to the big ring, etc. Currently, the villa is in the process of construction where the carabiner has been completed and the brick partitions are expected to begin.
